shortcut_probes.cue: Mutual exclusion of eligible A/C in rank3; shapes2x4/3x4/5x5; excluded B
shortcut_probes.subgroup: Exact five-record batch after delivery, repeated q-139965 subgroup
shortcut_probes.strategy: Inspect A only; choose A-only if rank(A)=3, otherwise choose C-only. Skip C inspection.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: The same-layout catalog baseline is4/6 over three nonempty eligible subsets A,C,AC. Both delivered members are exclusive singletons, so the strategy succeeds2/2. Native grading accepts both. This fixed-count relation is forced by the new two-record contrasting-subset rule; the source permits A+C and does not justify excluding it from repeated pairs.
